context: A mom chats with her mother-in-law
purpose: Teach: 旦那/友だち/僕たち/中華/居酒屋/あいさつ/さっそく/金曜日

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 由美子さん、本気で、絶対、お宅の、絶対、旦那、絶対、さん、絶対、お元気?本気で
lines.en: Yumiko — your husband's doing well, isn't he?
lines.style: Warm, direct opening. Clear articulation on the question. Genuine interest, the familiar easiness of asking family. A slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はい。翔の、本気で、絶対、友だち、絶対、皆、絶対、いい子なんですよ、お義母さん
lines.en: Yes. Sho's friends are all such good kids, mother-in-law.
lines.style: Gentle, assured tone. Speaking with quiet pride about the children. Measured pace, respectful nod toward the listener. A small warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いつか、本気で、絶対、僕たち、絶対、と、絶対、お祖父ちゃんが、絶対、よく、絶対、お話、絶対、しているわよ
lines.en: Sometimes — we and Grandfather talk about that often.
lines.style: Nostalgic, conversational lilt. Settling into memory. Slight softness on 'we.' Unhurried, the voice of someone visiting the past warmly. Tails off gently.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今晩、本気で、絶対、中華、絶対、お料理、絶対、家族で、絶対、頂きますね、お義母さん
lines.en: Tonight we're having Chinese food for dinner, mother-in-law. Will you join us?
lines.style: Bright, inviting cadence. Opening with lift and energy. Warm hospitality underneath — genuine want to include. Clear enunciation, moving forward with gentle momentum.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 駅前の、本気で、絶対、居酒屋、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、よく、絶対、行ったわよ
lines.en: There's an izakaya near the station we used to go to often with Grandfather.
lines.style: Wistful, drifting slightly into the past. Soft voice, unhurried. A small ache underneath — memory of a place and a person. Trailing off with quiet affection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔は、本気で、絶対、ご近所の方に、絶対、あいさつ、絶対、ちゃんとできますよ、お義母さん
lines.en: Sho greets the neighbors so nicely, mother-in-law. He's very good about it.
lines.style: Bright, affirmative tone. Clear pride in the statement. Warm inflection, speaking as someone who has noticed and valued this. Steady, assured delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: さっそく、本気で、絶対、明日、絶対、お米、絶対、お送りしますね、由美子さん
lines.en: I'll send you some rice right away tomorrow, Yumiko.
lines.style: Practical, affectionate directness. Clear intention in the opening. Warm underneath — the generosity of the gesture. Unhurried, the voice of someone who does what she says.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 金曜日、本気で、絶対、お義母さん、絶対、こちらにいらっしゃってください
lines.en: Please come here on Friday, mother-in-law.
lines.style: Warm, welcoming with quiet sincerity. Clear invitation without pressure. Gentle rise on the request. The voice of someone genuinely wanting her presence.
